I categorize debt in three ways:

  1. Non-working debt. Debt on things that degrade in value, like cars.
  2. Neutral debt. Debt on things that will allow you to, for the most part, break even. Like your house.
  3. Working debt. Debt on things that will make more profit than the interest you pay. Like a rental property, or a business.

Debt slavery isn't a very useful term, it scares people away from debt. Maybe it applies to #1, but debt is something you can leverage to your advantage if you are smart with it. Like #2 and #3.
